high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene at what appears to be a park or open area during sunset. The central focus is a large statue of a person riding a horse, mounted on a pedestal. The statue is positioned slightly off-center, with the sun setting behind it, creating a warm, golden glow that bathes the entire scene. The setting includes a mix of natural and urban elements. In the foreground, there is a patch of grass and some low-lying vegetation, which adds a touch of nature to the otherwise urban environment.
